resources.string: Battery optimisation can freeze the runtime in the background. Allow the app to ignore it.
Starting is taking unusually long. A self-test is running now; wait for it to finish (a minute or two), then press Settings > Diagnostics > Copy diagnostics and send it.
Self-test running. Wait for it to finish before you copy the diagnostics, so the dump contains its result.
Something failed. Once no self-test is running, press Settings > Diagnostics > Copy diagnostics and send it.
How should the agent reach Gemini?
User credentials JSON (Vertex AI, gcloud login)
Uses generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Model ids are plain, for example gemini-4-hydrogen.
Uses aiplatform.googleapis.com with an express-mode key. Adding a project routes to its global location, which Gemini 4 Argon needs.
Import the key file of a service account that has the Vertex AI User role.
Import the application_default_credentials.json that gcloud auth application-default login creates (type authorized_user). It carries no project, so enter the project id below.
Nothing imported for this mode yet.
Default leaves it to Hermes (medium). Lower levels answer faster and cost less.
Unknown thinking effort. Pick one of the chips.
User credentials contain no project: enter the project id.
Project id may only contain lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
Region may only contain lowercase letters, digits and -.
The runtime is up, but the saved setup is incomplete (credentials or fields). Finish Setup and press Save and apply.
No credentials imported for this mode yet.
Saved. Takes effect the next time the runtime starts.
Saved. Restarting the runtime to apply.
Every provider keeps its own key on this phone. Switching provider never deletes the others.
One key reaches hundreds of models. Model ids look like vendor/model, for example google/gemini-3.8-flash. OpenRouter keys start with sk-or-.
Claude models straight from Anthropic. Model ids are plain, for example claude-sonnet-5.
The OpenAI API (api.openai.com). Model ids are plain, for example gpt-5.4.

Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat API: a hosted service, or Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM on your own network. Use the base URL its documentation gives (often ending in /v1) and the model id it serves.
API key (leave empty if the server needs none)
Enter an API key for this provider.
OpenRouter keys start with sk-or-. Hermes would ignore this one.
Enter the base URL of the server.
This address is not accepted. Use https://..., or http:// only for this phone or your own network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x). No user name, password or query.
Plain http: the traffic is not encrypted. Allowed only because the address is on this phone or your own network.
Paste the whole file. The text is hidden, checked, stored privately and then cleared from this field.
Service account for project %1$s, %2$s. The mode was switched to service account.
User credentials: %1$s. The mode was switched to user credentials; enter the project id.
Line breaks from the copy were repaired automatically.
Nothing to import: the text is empty.

The private_key is not a PEM private key (it must contain BEGIN PRIVATE KEY … END PRIVATE KEY).
The file could not be read (or is larger than 256 KB).
Sets PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1. Slower, but try it if the runtime dies with signal 31 (SIGSYS). Restart afterwards.
Diagnostics copied, but TRUNCATED to %1$d of %2$d characters (clipboard limit). Use Share as file for the complete dump.
